meta.name: Lifting The Veil
meta.description: Lifting The Veilexplores the historical role of political parties in the United States as the graveyard of social movements, the massive influence of corporate financing in elections, the absurd disparities of wealth, the continuity and escalation of neoconservative policies with the Obama administration, the insufficiency of mere voting as a path to reform, and differing conceptions of democracy itself.Lifting The Veilexposes the vast hypocrisy of the United States government, with a sense of urgency to bring about real systemic social and political change…
